title: UPPLAND loveseat
description: UPPLAND loveseat, Kelinge beige You know the feeling when you sit, lie down or hang out in a sofa, rather than on it. That’s how embracing the deep and generous UPPLAND sofa is – your new favorite place for cozy evenings and lazy days!
